assistant|lentil_bolognese_recipe_time: Lentil bolognese takes 30-40 minutes to cook
assistant|lentil_bolognese_ingredients: Ingredients: 1 cup dried green/brown lentils, onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, carrot, celery stalk, 28 oz crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper, 1/4 cup red wine (optional)
assistant|lentil_bolognese_method: Method: saute onion, garlic, carrot, celery 5-7 min; add mushrooms 5 min; add lentils and spices; add tomatoes and wine; simmer covered 20-25 min until lentils tender
assistant|lentil_bolognese_serving: Serve over quinoa, with roasted vegetables, or as a pasta/veg sauce
assistant|lentil_bolognese_variations: Variations: mix lentil types; add bay leaves, thyme or rosemary; add tomato paste; try porcini mushrooms; add bell peppers or zucchini in last 10 minutes
assistant|side_suggestion_roasted_veggie: Suggested roasted sides: broccoli with garlic and lemon; Brussels sprouts with balsamic and nuts; sweet potato wedges with rosemary; carrots with cumin and coriander; asparagus with Parmesan and lemon zest
assistant|side_suggestion_greens: Suggested sauteed greens: spinach with garlic and lemon; kale with cherry tomatoes and balsamic; collard greens with onions and smoked paprika
assistant|side_suggestion_crunchy: Suggested crunchy add-ins: toasted pumpkin seeds; fresh parsley or cilantro; crushed red pepper flakes; almonds, walnuts or pecans
assistant|side_suggestion_cheese: Suggested cheese toppings: shaved Parmesan; crumbled feta; grated mozzarella or ricotta
assistant|side_suggestion_other: Suggested other add-ins: bell peppers; fresh basil, oregano or thyme; artichoke hearts; avocado
assistant|meal_prep_tip_batch: Advised roasting vegetables ahead (fridge up to 5 days), batching quinoa for the week, freezing double-batch bolognese up to 3 months
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_classic: Classic Herbs: olive oil, salt, pepper, fresh rosemary/thyme/sage, or dried oregano/basil/parsley
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_spicy: Spicy Kick: olive oil, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, optional cayenne or red pepper flakes
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_mediter: Mediterranean: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, dried oregano, optional kalamata olives or artichoke hearts
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_sweet_s: Sweet and Smoky: olive oil, brown sugar, smoked paprika, cayenne, optional bacon or diced onions
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_indian: Indian-Inspired: olive oil, garam masala, cumin, coriander, optional cilantro or scallions
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_lemon_r: Lemon Rosemary: olive oil, lemon zest, minced garlic, fresh rosemary, lemon juice before serving
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_simple: Simple option: olive oil, salt and pepper
assistant|roasted_sweet_potato_rosemary_: Recipe: 2-3 large sweet potatoes cubed, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary, salt, pepper; roast at 425F (220C) 20-25 min, flipping halfway
assistant|granola_tip_sweetness: Granola sweetness can be adjusted by reducing/omitting honey or maple syrup, or drizzling after cooling
assistant|granola_tip_spices: Granola spice options: cinnamon, nutmeg, cardamom, vanilla extract, or cocoa powder
assistant|granola_tip_nuts_seeds: Granola nut/seed options: almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, chia, flax, hemp, or nut butter
assistant|granola_tip_dried_fruit: Granola dried fruit options: cranberries, raisins, cherries, apricots, apples, pineapple, or omit for crunchy granola
assistant|granola_tip_grains: Granola grain options: rolled oats, quinoa, Kamut, puffed rice or wheat
assistant|granola_tip_mixins: Granola other mix-ins: coconut flakes, dark chocolate chips or M&M's, cereal pieces like Cheerios or Cinnamon Toast Crunch
